task_summary: Unify hierarchical product category taxonomies from Amazon, Facebook, and Google Shopping into a single 5-level taxonomy via offline semantic clustering.
decomposition_rationale: The task splits naturally into data ingestion/normalization, semantic embedding + hierarchical clustering, and cluster naming/output formatting. Three skills keep each concern self-contained without overlap.

skills.name: evo-taxonomy-data-pipeline
skills.description: Load, normalize, and output e-commerce category taxonomy data using Pandas 2.2.0-safe patterns. Use when ingesting source CSVs (Amazon/Facebook/Google), splitting hierarchical paths, deduplicating, and writing the final unified taxonomy CSVs.
skills.responsibility: CSV I/O, schema normalization across the three platforms, path splitting, text cleanup, deduplication, and writing final output files (unified_taxonomy_full.csv and unified_taxonomy_hierarchy.csv).

skills.name: evo-semantic-hierarchical-clustering
skills.description: Generate sentence embeddings for category strings and build a balanced 5-level hierarchy via recursive top-down agglomerative clustering. Use when needing offline semantic embeddings and SciPy/Sklearn-based hierarchical clustering with size constraints.
skills.responsibility: Offline embedding generation using sentence-transformers 2.5.1, condensed distance matrix computation, recursive top-down clustering with min/max children constraints to produce strictly nested 5-level cluster IDs.

skills.name: evo-cluster-naming
skills.description: Assign human-readable, non-overlapping representative names to clusters using centroid-nearest selection and TF-IDF, with sibling Jaccard-overlap checks. Use when labeling clustered taxonomy nodes with concise multi-word names.
skills.responsibility: Cluster naming via centroid proximity and TF-IDF top n-grams, enforcement of '<5 words' and ' | ' separator formatting, parent-child name overlap avoidance, and sibling distinctness via Jaccard overlap thresholds.
